source: 人教版2019选择性必修四 Unit 1 词表(真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、科幻/机器人/人工智能/时间旅行主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义;跳过专有名词。

words.example_en: Robots first appeared in science fiction novels long ago.
words.example_cn: 机器人很久以前就出现在科幻小说里了。

words.example_en: It is becoming hard to tell reality from fiction.
words.example_cn: 现在越来越难分清现实与虚构了。

words.example_en: The robot suddenly declared that it did not want to leave her.
words.example_cn: 机器人突然表明它不想离开她。

words.example_en: Have we lost the dignity of being the most intelligent creature?
words.example_cn: 我们是否已失去身为最聪明生物的那份尊严?

words.meaning_cn: 让(某人)离开;解散;解雇;消除
words.example_en: Some people dismiss the fear that AI will harm humans.
words.example_cn: 有些人对人工智能会伤害人类的担忧不以为然。

words.example_en: Soon there was a clear division between night and day.
words.example_cn: 很快昼夜之间就有了清晰的分界。

words.example_en: If the machine stopped in a solid object, it would explode like a bomb.
words.example_cn: 如果机器停在实体物里,就会像炸弹一样爆炸。

words.example_en: In the future a robot taxi may collect your fare automatically.
words.example_cn: 未来机器人出租车也许会自动收取你的车费。

words.example_en: Ordered by its master, the AI dog fetched the book from the shelf.
words.example_cn: 在主人的命令下,人工智能机器狗从书架上把书取了来。

words.example_en: With a sudden jolt, the Time Machine was flipped on its side.
words.example_cn: 随着一阵突然的颠簸,时间机器侧翻了过去。

words.example_en: Two hundred grammes of flour should be added to the cake mix by the kitchen robot.
words.example_cn: 厨房机器人应往蛋糕糊里加入两百克面粉。

words.example_en: I gripped the lever and pushed it forwards through time.
words.example_cn: 我紧握操纵杆,把它向前推动,穿越时间。

words.meaning_cn: 内疚的;有罪的;有过失的
words.example_en: The scientist felt guilty when his robot caused harm.
words.example_cn: 当他的机器人造成伤害时,这位科学家感到内疚。

words.example_en: The laboratory went hazy around me as I sped through time.
words.example_cn: 当我飞速穿越时间时,实验室在我周围变得朦胧。

words.example_en: A robot may not, through inaction, allow a human being to come to harm.
words.example_cn: 机器人不得因不作为而让人类受到伤害。

words.example_en: We believe he is a man of integrity and trust his words completely.
words.example_cn: 我们相信他是个正直的人,完全信任他的话。

words.example_en: With a sudden jolt, the Time Machine threw me through the air.
words.example_cn: 随着一阵突然的颠簸,时间机器把我抛向空中。

words.example_en: Robots will probably do most of our labour for us in the future.
words.example_cn: 未来机器人很可能会替我们干大部分体力活。

words.example_en: Claire fell off the ladder, but Tony caught her in time.
words.example_cn: 克莱尔从梯子上摔下来,但托尼及时接住了她。

words.example_en: Night came as if a lamp was being turned out.
words.example_cn: 黑夜降临,仿佛一盏灯正被熄灭。

words.example_en: I sat myself in the leather seat of the Time Machine.
words.example_cn: 我在时间机器的皮座椅上坐了下来。

words.example_en: I pushed the starting lever on the main panel forwards an inch.
words.example_cn: 我把主控制板上的启动杆向前推了一英寸。

words.meaning_cn: 最大极限的;最大量;最大限度
words.example_en: So long as I travelled at maximum speed, it did not matter.
words.example_cn: 只要我以最高速度行进,就没有问题。

words.example_en: I was sitting in the rain in some mud next to the machine.
words.example_cn: 我坐在机器旁的雨中,身陷泥泞。

words.example_en: Not a single nail was loose on the well-built robot.
words.example_cn: 这台做工精良的机器人,没有一颗螺钉松动。

words.example_en: My niece came in to fetch something, without seeing me at all.
words.example_cn: 我的外甥女进来拿东西,却根本没看见我。

words.example_en: A good sci-fi writer may use overstatement to make a story vivid.
words.example_cn: 优秀的科幻作家会用夸张手法让故事更生动。

words.example_en: As my pace grew faster, the walls of the laboratory fell away.
words.example_cn: 随着我的速度加快,实验室的墙壁渐渐消失。

words.meaning_cn: 控制板;仪表盘;专家咨询组
words.example_en: The starting lever sat on the main panel of the machine.
words.example_cn: 启动杆位于机器的主控制板上。

words.example_en: Whoever is charged with a crime should be presumed innocent until proven guilty.
words.example_cn: 任何被指控犯罪的人在被证实有罪前都应被假定为无罪。

words.example_en: Trees grew like puffs of smoke and died in moments.
words.example_cn: 树木如一缕缕青烟般长出,又在顷刻间枯死。

words.example_en: I had a strong urge to look at the random things flashing before my eyes.
words.example_cn: 我有股强烈的冲动想看清眼前一闪而过的杂乱景象。

words.example_en: The idea of robots ruling the world once sounded ridiculous.
words.example_cn: 机器人统治世界的想法曾经听起来很荒谬。

words.example_en: Rumours are like sharp knives, so we should not spread unkind news.
words.example_cn: 谣言如利刃,所以我们不该散播伤人的消息。

words.example_en: I found that the salesman's salary was being discussed at the meeting.
words.example_cn: 我发现会上正在讨论那位推销员的薪水。

words.example_en: In some shops a robot salesman now greets every customer.
words.example_cn: 在一些商店里,现在由机器人售货员迎接每位顾客。

words.example_en: I was stunned for a moment, and then heard the sound of thunder.
words.example_cn: 我愣了片刻,接着听到了雷声。

words.meaning_cn: 更好的;占优势的;(级别上)更高的
words.example_en: In sci-fi stories, robots often become superior and take over.
words.example_cn: 在科幻故事里,机器人常常变得更强大并取而代之。

words.example_en: The company had to suspend the space exploration project due to money problems.
words.example_cn: 由于资金问题,公司不得不暂停太空探索项目。

words.meaning_cn: 占上风;取而代之;接管;接手
words.example_en: Many people fear that one day machines will take over the world.
words.example_cn: 许多人担心有一天机器会接管整个世界。

words.example_en: Robot soldiers have already been tested out in real war.
words.example_cn: 机器人士兵已经在真实战争中被试用过了。

words.example_en: Night came as if a lamp was being turned out by an unseen hand.
words.example_cn: 黑夜降临,仿佛一盏灯被一只看不见的手熄灭。

words.meaning_cn: 强烈的欲望;冲动;催促;力劝
words.example_en: I had a strong urge to stop the machine and look around.
words.example_cn: 我有股强烈的冲动想停下机器四处看看。

words.meaning_cn: 活动场地(如音乐厅、会场等)
words.example_en: A 3,000-seat venue is being built for the robot science fair.
words.example_cn: 一个三千座的场馆正在为机器人科学展搭建。

words.example_en: The AI device sends a weekly report on the family's health.
words.example_cn: 这台人工智能设备每周发送一份家庭健康报告。

words.example_en: A human's facial expression changes often, whereas the robot's never changes.
words.example_cn: 人的面部表情常常变化,而机器人的却从不改变。

words.example_en: I calculated that I was being pushed through time at hundreds of years a minute.
words.example_cn: 我推算出自己正以每分钟数百年的速度被推过时间。

words.example_en: A robot must obey orders unless they conflict with the First Law.
words.example_cn: 机器人必须服从命令,除非这些命令与第一定律相冲突。

words.example_en: As robots become more intelligent, they may also become more dangerous.
words.example_cn: 随着机器人越来越智能,它们也可能变得越来越危险。

words.example_en: A robot that looks like a human is a fascinating possibility.
words.example_cn: 一个看起来像人类的机器人是个迷人的可能性。
